comments.content: The loop that marks descendants as invalid only iterates over `cand_invalid_descendants.equal_range(invalid_walk_tip)`, which contains candidates whose fork point is exactly `invalid_walk_tip`. However, `invalid_walk_tip` changes as we walk up the chain during invalidation. Descendants that fork at a higher ancestor (e.g., a block that forks at `invalid_walk_tip->pprev`) will not be marked in this iteration. This can leave blocks with `BLOCK_FAILED_VALID` unmarked, violating the new assertion in `CheckBlockIndex` that all descendants of invalid blocks must have `BLOCK_FAILED_MASK` set. The marking should be performed for all candidates that descend from any invalidated block, not just those forking at the current `invalid_walk_tip`.
